def: peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith, an epithet of Solomon's queen

occurrences.text: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
